extraction.description: The screenshot shows the UiPath Agents Evaluation Sets page for an evaluation set named “Benefits Evaluation Set (copy)”. The Evaluations tab is active, and the Applied Evaluators selector is open, showing available evaluators with “Conclusion Evaluator” and “Calculation Evaluator” selected while the default evaluators are unchecked. A search box and evaluation table header are visible below.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the Applied Evaluators pencil icon to open the evaluator selector. Select Conclusion Evaluator and Calculation Evaluator from the list, leaving Default Trajectory Evaluator and Default Evaluator unchecked. Verify that the selected evaluators appear as chips next to Applied Evaluators.
